title: 第19章 波涛下的暗流第20章 宙斯的算计
lines: 它们再也无法随心所欲地离开巢穴，去遥远的浅海肆虐；也无法因为无聊或食欲，就将路过的凡人拖入深渊。
更让它们憋闷的是，连通过猎杀吞噬同类来进化的“传统”路径也被斩断。
几乎在同一时间，波塞冬也对那些生性顽劣，凡人性命如草芥的海洋仙女与精怪们进行了整顿。
尤其是塞壬这类以魅惑与杀戮为乐的存在，被严令禁止再用歌声诱杀凡人。
对于黄金种族而言，被塞壬拖入深海并非死亡，却意味着在黑暗、压力与永恒溺毙感中的无限期囚禁，堪称最恶毒的酷刑。
波塞冬的“新政”在海洋中引起了轩然大波。
有人敬畏服从，有人默默观望，也有人......
在阳光永远无法触及的深海最幽暗之处，一座由珊瑚与苍白巨骨垒砌而成的庞大宫殿内。
原始海神蓬托斯，这位古老而强大的神祇，正听着下属的汇报。
他那由海水与阴影凝聚而成的面容，逐渐拧成了一团。
“你是说，波塞冬那个乳臭未干的小鬼，刚坐上位置就敢在我们经营了无数世代的地盘上，指手画脚，定下规矩？”
汇报的是一位下半身是斑斓海蛇，上半身是妖艳女子的仙女，她战战兢兢地补充道：
“蓬托斯大人，与其说是破坏，不如说他是加强了管束。我们不能再像以前那样随心所欲地捕食那些岸上的两脚羊，也不能随意互相狩猎了。”
“那他妈不是一个意思吗！！！”
蓬托斯的怒吼让整个宫殿的海水都沸腾起来，无数依附于此的小型生物惊慌逃窜。
“他敢动老子定下的规矩，分明是在削弱我的影响力！是在挑战我作为海洋原始主宰的权威！赢了克洛诺斯，就真以为这七海已经是他们奥林匹斯小辈的囊中之物了？天真！可笑！”
蓬托斯周身爆发出恐怖的原始神力，那是比寻常泰坦更加古老，更加接近世界本源的力量。
“看来我这位大海真正的主人，有必要亲自出面教教这位新来的小朋友，什么叫做‘尊重前辈’了！”
“可是，蓬托斯大人，其他古老的存在，比如涅柔斯他们，未必会愿意随我们一同对抗波塞冬。毕竟，他得到了俄刻阿诺斯的认可......”蛇身仙女忧心忡忡道。
“不必担心。我早有准备。大海可从来不只是表面看起来那么单纯。”
蓬托斯冷笑一声，眼中闪烁起阴谋的光芒。
而在另一处，由发光珊瑚与珍珠贝类构筑的瑰丽宫殿群中，一场姐妹间的争执正在上演。
这里是涅瑞伊得斯，即海仙女们居住的领域。她们是古老海神涅柔斯与多里斯的五十个女儿，通常以美丽、善良与歌声闻名。
但此刻，位列涅瑞伊得斯实力前三的仙女忒提斯，正满脸怒容地看着她最年长，也最受尊敬的姐姐安菲特里忒。
安菲特里忒有着一头如同月光洒在波浪上的银蓝色长发，容貌端庄秀丽，气质温和而睿智，是诸多海洋仙女实际上的领导者与调解者。
“姐姐！波塞冬那家伙也太傲慢了吧？他凭什么划定海怪的活动范围？凭什么连我们姐妹在海中巡游，与海豚嬉戏都要受到规则的约束？我们可是蓬托斯大人的血亲！是海洋天生的贵族！”
此时忒提斯美丽的脸上充满了不甘与愤懑。
content_en:
They can no longer leave their nests and wreak havoc in distant shallow seas at will; nor can they drag passing mortals into the abyss out of boredom or appetite.
What makes them even more depressed is that even the "traditional" path to evolution by hunting and devouring their own kind has been cut off.
Almost at the same time, Poseidon also rectified the sea nymphs and spirits who were naughty by nature and whose mortal lives were worthless.
In particular, beings like the Sirens, who took pleasure in charming and killing, were strictly prohibited from luring and killing mortals with their songs.
For the golden race, being dragged into the deep sea by the siren is not death, but it means indefinite imprisonment in darkness, pressure and the feeling of eternal drowning. It can be called the most vicious torture.
Poseidon's "New Deal" caused an uproar in the ocean.
Some people obey in awe, some watch silently, and some...
...
In the darkest part of the deep sea where the sun can never reach, there is a huge palace built of coral and pale bones.
The original sea god Pontos, this ancient and powerful god, was listening to the report of his subordinates.
His face, which was composed of sea water and shadow, gradually twisted into a ball.
"You mean, that little brat Poseidon dares to dictate and set rules on the territory we have managed for countless generations just after he took the position?"
The person reporting was a fairy whose lower body was a colorful sea snake and her upper body was a voluptuous woman. She added cautiously:
"Lord Pontos, rather than destroying it, it is better to say that he has tightened control. We can no longer prey on the two-legged sheep on the shore as we did before, nor can we hunt each other at will."
"Then it doesn't mean the same thing!!!"
Pontos' roar caused the seawater in the entire palace to boil, and countless small creatures attached to it fled in panic.
"He dares to violate the rules set by me. He is clearly weakening my influence! He is challenging my authority as the original master of the ocean! After defeating Cronus, do you really think that the seven seas are already in the possession of their Olympus juniors? Naive! Ridiculous!"
Pontos' body erupted with terrifying primitive divine power, which was a power that was older than ordinary Titans and closer to the origin of the world.
"It seems that I, the true master of the sea, need to personally teach this new kid what it means to 'respect the seniors'!"
"But Lord Pontos, other ancient beings, such as Nereus and the others, may not be willing to fight with us against Poseidon. After all, he has been recognized by Oceanos..." the snake-bodied fairy said worriedly.
"Don't worry. I've been prepared. The sea is never as simple as it seems."
Pontos sneered, his eyes flashing with conspiracy.
...
Elsewhere, in a group of magnificent palaces built of luminous corals and pearl shellfish, a dispute between sisters is taking place.
This is the Nereids, the realm where the sea nymphs live. They are the fifty daughters of the ancient sea gods Nereus and Doris, usually known for their beauty, kindness and singing.
But at this moment, the fairy Thetis, who ranked among the top three Nereids in terms of strength, was looking at her eldest and most respected sister Amphitrite with an angry look on her face.
Amphitrite has long silver-blue hair that looks like moonlight on the waves. She has a dignified and beautiful appearance, a gentle and wise temperament, and is the de facto leader and mediator of many sea fairies.
"Sister! Isn't that guy Poseidon too arrogant? Why does he delimit the scope of activities of sea monsters? Why do we, sisters, even have to be bound by rules when we cruise in the sea and play with dolphins? We are the blood relatives of Sir Pontos! We are the natural nobles of the ocean!"
At this time, Thetis' beautiful face was full of unwillingness and resentment.
